name: SkySlope
positioning: Built for the broker's compliance problem first, and the agent's paperwork second.
description: SkySlope is a transaction and compliance platform for brokerages, with digital forms (SkySlope Forms), e-signature (DigiSign), offer management (Offers) and broker audit workflows. Its centre of gravity is the file review queue rather than the agent experience.
real_estate_use: A brokerage with a legal obligation to retain complete files uses SkySlope to enforce what "complete" means. Each transaction type carries a required-document checklist, files route to a reviewer, rejections come back with a reason, and the archive survives a state audit years later. Listing and sale files are separated so a listing that never sells is still auditable.
features: Broker file review with per-transaction-type document checklists
SkySlope Forms with state and association form libraries
DigiSign e-signature bound to the transaction file
Offers — structured offer submission and comparison for listing agents
Retention-grade archive with full audit history

use_cases.job: Guarantee that every closed file is audit-complete before it is archived
Collect and compare multiple offers on a listing in a structured view
